pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual patches exhibit predominantly polygonal geometry with sharp edge gradients and angular vertices. Spatial area of patches is greatest on the mid-flank, transitioning to smaller, more condensed and slightly elongated units towards the lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored negative space forms a continuous topological web of interconnected pathways. Junction nodes are predominantly trivalent, and the pixel thickness of these corridors remains narrow and relatively uniform across the visible flank area.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck presents a jagged 1D geometric silhouette with a moderate frequency of serrations visible against the background.
